name: Police- Community Relations Awards 2016
description: This dataset lists recipients of Police-Community Relations Awards in 2016, with one row per funded organization or project. Each record includes the organization name, project title, project address, fiscal year of the award, postcode, borough, latitude and longitude, community board, council district, census tract, building identification number (BIN), borough-block-lot number (BBL), and neighborhood tabulation area (NTA). The geographic fields make it possible to map award locations and compare them across neighborhoods and administrative boundaries. The data could be used to examine where community-policing and relationship-building projects were funded, analyze geographic patterns in award distribution, join award locations to other neighborhood-level datasets, or support transparency and community outreach around public spending.
